name: SCAS Fertilizer Knowledge Base - Starter v1
purpose: Authoritative, traceable starter knowledge for the SCAS fertilizer engine.
status: STARTER / SOURCE-TRACEABLE — not a universal fertilizer prescription engine
priority_rule: Use state/crop/region-specific package-of-practice recommendations when STCR is unavailable.
Never present a blanket dose as universally valid.
Every recommendation returned to a farmer must retain crop, region/condition, source, unit and confidence/explanation metadata.

fertilizers.source: Government of India / fertilizer-sector references; fertilizer-grade urea is 46% nitrogen.
fertilizers.source_note: Composition is a product-grade fact; application dosage must come from crop/region/soil recommendations, not from this catalog alone.

fertilizers.source: Department of Fertilizers / Government of India fertilizer references
fertilizers.source_note: Indian fertilizer specifications identify DAP as 18-46-0; crop dosage must be derived from soil/crop recommendations.

fertilizers.source: Department of Fertilizers / Government of India fertilizer references
fertilizers.source_note: Government fertilizer documentation lists MOP as 0-0-60; crop dosage must be derived from soil/crop recommendations.

fertilizers.source: Use only when the applicable Indian fertilizer specification/product label is verified.
fertilizers.source_note: Do not treat this grade as universal across products; SCAS should store verified product-grade data separately.
Dosage is deficiency- and crop-specific. SCAS must not infer a universal dose from the catalog.
Use only under crop/soil-specific recommendation; avoid universal dosage.

crop_recommendations.source: University of Agricultural Sciences, GKVK Bengaluru; Mysore Journal of Agricultural Sciences
crop_recommendations.caution: This is a regional general recommendation, not a universal prescription. Prefer soil-test/STCR recommendations when available.

crop_recommendations.caution: This is a package-of-practice reference from a specific Karnataka research context. Targeted-yield/STCR equations can produce different doses.

coverage_note: This starter catalog deliberately does not fabricate fertilizer rules for all 22 ML crops. Additional crop/state/soil rules must be added from traceable agricultural sources before those crops are exposed to production fertilizer recommendations.
